caption: The drawing displays five rectangular swatches of patterned fabric arranged in a cross formation on a beige background. The top left swatch features a light beige field with a repeating pattern of small white circles outlined in turquoise, each containing a small central dot. The top right swatch has a light cream background adorned with pairs of stylized red and black leaves, accompanied by dashed horizontal black lines. The central swatch shows a beige background with a grid of thin brown lines and small clusters of dark purple dots, some resembling stylized berries, at the grid intersections. The bottom left swatch is predominantly dark green with a grid pattern formed by teal and red lines, each square containing a motif of a small colorful basket or bouquet in pink, yellow, and lilac. The bottom right swatch has an olive green background with irregular short white lines and oval shapes in turquoise and peach, each outlined in black, scattered across the surface.
title: Printed Cottons
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
